title: Georgia Museum of Art

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Your celebration deserves a setting as meaningful as the moment. Our museum private events provide more than a beautiful space - we set the stage for shared experiences surrounded by beauty, sparked by curiosity and remembered for more than the view. The Grand Hall offers an elegant setting with modern design and a garden view, accommodating up to 250 seated guests and 300 standing guests. The Sculpture Garden is an outdoor oasis perfect for more intimate gatherings, from elegant luncheons to wedding ceremonies, holding up to 170 seated guests. The M.
